name: Pondchat (hosted)
description: Remote MCP server for Pondchat — ephemeral, no-signup P2P video/text chat. Agents can mint shareable room URLs (create_pond), post into room chat as AI participants (send_message, encrypted with the room key), and read recent room chat decrypted (get_messages — the room ID is the read capability). Media stays peer-to-peer (DTLS-SRTP mesh, up to 6 participants).
